notes.title: Play your own music in Fractal Fly!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Mzq9QM09CdM;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]You can now play your own music files.
Supported formats:  
- mp3
- ogg
- wav
- flac
- aiff
- aif
- mod
- it
- s3m
- xm

notes.title: Performance improvement and GPU compatibility fix
notes.content:
- A new improvement in the rendering engine offers a gain around 10 to 15 percent in rendering time.
- Prevent crash when running on integrated GPU. Also now a GPU compatibility test is done when launching, to display a message if fractal rendering may not be possible.

notes.title: Performance fix, no more bloom in VR, add a setting for speed control
notes.content:
- Performances were downgraded in previous version, it should now be fixed.
- In VR, picture looks shimmered, like with oily glasses. It was the bloom effect that was added in flat screen and VR version. But as it's a camera lens effect this doesn't felle natural at all in VR. So it's removed.
- In last version, speed close to surface was far more slower. It was to make the flight easy for everyobiody. But the modification was actually frustating for many, so there is now a "speed close to surface" setting so it should make everyone happy.

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v4.2023.07.09
notes.content:
- Add an option to invert roll controls.
- Controls inversion is now also available in VR.
- Fix gamepad cursor that wasn't movable in horizontal direction when Fractal Fly was run in portrait mode.

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v3.2023.04.01
notes.content: Fix display issue on Intel's integrated GPU (colors were all reddish and very saturated).

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v3.2023.03.25
notes.content:
Optimization of "Mineral Sky" rendering time: 
      - Average of 1.68 times faster in very high detail level.
      - Average of 1.47 times faster in high detail level.
      - Average of 1.22 times faster in good detail level.
      - Average of 1.11 times faster in low detail level.
      - Average of 1.04 times faster in very low detail level.

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v2.2022.08.27
notes.content:
Main modifications:
- Improve rendering quality at low res: In Fractal Fly internal resolution gets automatically lower if graphic card isn't rendering fast enough. In last month update rendering turned to be blurry, rounded and messy when internal resolution was getting low. This shouldn't be the case anymore, though you may get some shimmering.
- Speed changes between when you're zoomed or not (you wont go as fast at the size of an ant as at your normal size). But the speed change was annoying and very perceptible. It should now be less disturbing.

Other modifications: 
- Fine tune shadows.
- Color and detail fine tuning in Bubble cave.

notes.title: First big update of Fractal Fly! - v2.2022.07.29
notes.content:
This is the first big update of Fractal Fly.
You can take a look at this YouTube video to know more about this update: [previewyoutube=bvmKYq3DkpI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Here is a more detailed list of new features:
- There is now a variable zoom level. 
- There is also Fractal endless repetition (but not on Bubble Cave).
- Morph leads to a very diffrent result for Bubble cave.
- Big gisplay enhancements for Undersea forest.
- You can now choose fractal detail level.
- Morphing UI has been added.
- You can choose VR controller model.
- You got help on the VR controller itself to know the controls.

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v1.2022.03.21
notes.content: Fixes vertical ripples that appeared for some people with previous update.

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v1.2022.03.20
notes.content:
- Fixes incorrect image ratio that could happen in some cases in VR.
- Sliders in settings pane are now far easier to manipulate in VR.

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v1.2022.03.13
notes.content: Fixes unwanted blue round corners that some people encounter in VR.

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v1.2022.03.06
notes.content: Fix for fisheye FOV as well as "3D looking off" issues in VR (hopefully will fix all reported issues).

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v1.2022.2.26
notes.content:
- Better UI in Screen (non VR) mode! It's not any more a 3D UI running on a screen, it's a full 2D UI, so it will adapt to each screen ratios.
- No more "walls opening" animation, replaced by a quicker fade in / fade out.
- Add ability to set field of view (though it's not available in VR (in VR field of view is determined by the VR headset itself)).
- Add settings screen in the pause menu.

notes.title: Fractal Fly update notes - v1.2022.2.19
notes.content:
- Display a message if VR wasn't able to activate, explaining the issue and how to fix it (have to set OpenXR defaults to SteamVR).
- In Screen (non VR) mode, add X and Y inversion setting for pad and mouse movement.
- In VR positions controllers away by default, so they are not annoying player sight when controllers are still not activated.
- Prevent the gamepad cursor to display when in VR mode.
